cases.name: a full archive becomes a new campaign: every id is new, every reference follows its copy, the ids held in the versions too
an archive exported before media, sounds and sessions joined it copies with those three sections empty
an archive whose origin_campaign_id names a campaign that still exists copies under a new campaign id and keeps that origin, not the one of the campaign it was itself copied from
a reference to something outside the archive becomes null, and a link row whose other end is outside is left out
